items.question: What is No Barriers, No Excuses?
items.answer: A community-driven movement within triathlon that works to reduce bias, increase access, and create fairer environments for all athletes. We unite volunteers, ambassadors, clubs, coaches and decision-makers to make the sport more inclusive from the ground up.

items.question: Is this only for people who experience discrimination?
items.answer: No. Anyone in or around triathlon is welcome — athletes, coaches, technical officials, federation staff, volunteers and allies. If you want a fairer sport, you belong here.

items.question: Why does triathlon need a project like this?
items.answer: Because access, visibility and support have never been equally distributed in the sport. Naming that pattern is the first step to changing it — this movement exists to widen the field, not to point fingers.

items.question: How do I get involved?
items.answer: Become an ambassador and start or join a group in your area (or remote), or register for our upcoming webinar to hear from people already pushing for change.
